integrity: A general two-case polynomial reduction supplies the proof. Finite modular rank computations independently corroborate 58 multipartite profiles (217 full-degree checks and 20 zero-degree checks), but are not treated as an infinite proof. No independently conducted audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite simple graphs with at least two nonempty parts. Matching-span equality is established by an all-orders integral identity; the stated Specht dimensions and Dunkl matching Hilbert formula are in characteristic zero. Earlier matching-duality and complete-graph dimensions are credited, and unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: Complete multipartite saturation for matching-difference spans
